name: The First Reopening
summary: The first reopened Mythos Gate opens under impossible pressure. The Creator learns how Deities, Mythos Gates, Hollow leakage, and Director governance function. Full mission-arc recreation pass now rewrites all seven Mythos Gates routes with route-native chapter arcs, mission titles, objectives, dialogue hooks, and mission art prompts.
loreDirectorNotes: Introduces canon without adding playable non-Deity entries or ordinary units. Mesha and the Hollow Mouth are non-playable narrative anchors.
gameplayDirectorNotes: Designed as the onboarding campaign: single active deity selection, map objectives, enemy turns, and Gate sealing. Current pass targets dungeon-route pacing, one-deity readability, shrine/treasure/boss nodes, and faction-specific hazard language.
artDirectorNotes: Needs approved artwork for the First Reopening Gate, Mesha, Hollow Wretch, and TG-TITAN-001.
